observation.problem: Cross-layer equality of a vector-control digest did not by itself prove that the digest named an externally admitted canonical JSPACE_VECTOR_CONTROL_ABI/v1 packet preimage.
observation.counterhypothesis: Shared digest identity might be sufficient if every upstream producer were already trusted and immutable; DatasetAdmission is explicitly a cross-boundary fail-closed gate, so that assumption is too strong for training-data admission.
observation.discriminator: Require a caller-owned admitted VectorControlPacket registry, validate the selected packet with the sole ABI validator, and cross-bind generation, basis, role and control condition. Preserve deterministic regressions for missing, mismatched and tampered preimages.
